finalText:
`POST /orders/:id/apply-coupon` is implemented and both `npm run build` and `npm test` pass (25 tests, including 20 new ones covering every acceptance criterion and error-code ordering).

What changed:

- [orderRepository.ts](/work/src/repositories/orderRepository.ts:62) — new `applyCoupon` that runs the three writes in a single `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` / `COMMIT` transaction (update order amounts + coupon code, insert redemption, increment `used_count`), rolling back on any failure.
- [orderService.ts](/work/src/services/orderService.ts:45) — `applyCoupon(id, couponCode)` holds all the business rules: normalization (trim + uppercase), the exact error-code ordering from §6, the `validFrom <= now < validUntil` window from the injected `Clock`, and the discount math (`FIXED`/`PERCENT` with floor, then `maxDiscountCents` cap, then clamp to `amountCents`).
- [orders.ts](/work/src/routes/orders.ts:9) — route that only parses the id and `couponCode`, delegating the rest to the service.
- [app.ts](/work/src/app.ts:29) — injects the coupon repository into `OrderService`.
- [apply-coupon.test.ts](/work/tests/apply-coupon.test.ts) — new tests; the existing test file and schema are untouched.

Two details worth flagging: the second-coupon rejection is checked before the coupon lookup so a second attempt on an already-couponed order returns `COUPON_ALREADY_APPLIED` even if the code is bogus, and the persisted `coupon_code` is the canonical stored code (`SAVE20`), so `" save20 "` matches and reads back uppercase.
